architectural_decisions.rationale: The platform is a web service that follows the client-server architecture, which uses a 3-layer architecture, where the system is divided into 3 layers.
This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform, increasing the security of the system by reducing the gateways to the outside.
The API Gateway gives the ability to handle partial system failures, managing which services are running at all times.
NestJS allows the creation of a secure and complex REST API in an easier way than using NodeJS directly.
TypeScript was chosen because it is the default language for NestJS and because, thanks to its static typing, it allows for error detection at compile time.
AWS was chosen for its low price and its previous use by the company.
Amazon Athena is a serverless service, which means it is not necessary to manage the infrastructure when there is an increase in the data set and users.
To obtain data quickly, Athena performs queries in parallel.
Kinesis Data Streams was used to transmit playlog and audit trail data to ensure the fastest possible data transmission.
The physical architecture is divided into several different services to improve the security, scalability, and availability of the system.
